name: Rakan
title: The Charmer

passive.name: Fey Feathers

description.normalized: Every 35 - 14 seconds, gain a 31 (+80% AP) health shield. Attacks and abilities on enemy champions reduce this cooldown by 1 second. Lover's Leap: Xayah and Rakan can join each other's recall. Both will reach Summoming Platform at the time of wich the initiator's recall ends.

q.name: Gleaming Quill

description.normalized: Fling a magical feather that deals 90 / 150 / 210 / 270 (+60% AP) magic damage to the first enemy hit. If the feather hits a champion or epic monster, Rakan restores 56 - 140 (+70% AP) health to himself and nearby allies after 3 seconds or when he touches an ally.

q.rawParsedText:
Fling a magical feather that deals 90 / 150 / 210 / 270 (+60% AP) magic damage to the first enemy hit.

If the feather hits a champion or epic monster, Rakan restores 56 - 140 (+70% AP) health to himself and nearby allies after 3 seconds or when he touches an ally.

w.name: Grand Entrance

description.normalized: Dashes to a location. Upon arrival Rakan leaps into the air, dealing 70 / 135 / 200 / 265 (+45% AP) magic damage and knocking up enemies for 1 second.

w.rawParsedText: Dashes to a location. Upon arrival Rakan leaps into the air, dealing 70 / 135 / 200 / 265 (+45% AP) magic damage and knocking up enemies for 1 second.

e.name: Battle Dance

description.normalized: Flies to an allied champion, granting them a shield that absorbs 50 / 80 / 110 / 140 (+65% AP) damage for 3 seconds. Can be re-cast for free within 5 seconds. When cast on Xayah, the shield amount is increased by 25% and the cooldown is reduced.

r.name: The Quickness

description.normalized: Gains 60% Movement Speed for 4 seconds. Touching enemies deals 100 / 200 / 300 (+50% AP) magic damage and charms them for 1 / 1.25 / 1.5 seconds. This may only occur once per unit. The first champion charmed grants Rakan 75% decaying Movement Speed.
